about: Script Lab (RLV tool) scenarios: control requests and the exact values of chosen answer fields. Run by tests/tst_scriptlabwhole.cpp (ControlApi) and tests/smoke_scriptlab.py (the real program). "source_file" is a file in examples/scriptlab. Each scenario starts with rlv_reset in its mode (default rlva). Expected values: PINGLYMOTION_UPDATE_SCENARIOS=1 writes them again; read the difference before committing.
